caption: Old town and beach, Sperlonga
composition: Whitewashed promontory above a curved sandy beach · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is the seafront promenade curving at the right, looking along the sandy beach to the whitewashed old town piled on its rocky promontory at the center right. Turquoise water laps the shore at the left, with hazy mountains closing the far horizon, and the town's church tower rises above the white rooftops. At 08:15 the light is bright and clear, and the beach lies empty.
